items.topic: Cursor Projects goes multiplayer: agents coordinate across a team
items.summary: Observed on X explore at 2026-11-11: Cursor rebuilt Projects for multiplayer. Multiple posts describe agents coordinating on a shared project; the official Cursor blog post is dated 2026-11-10. Heat shown by X: about 1.9K posts. One widely repeated detail — the '11 people, 62 agents' figure — appeared on X only in this capture and needs an independent source before it is treated as fact.
